proves.claim: statusLines renders a fixed summary with every section filled into the recorded status lines.

cli.logic-status-render.a-summary-with-e.why: Without it, a change to the status wording or order would reach every status reader unnoticed.

proves.claim: statusLines prints only the always-on lines for a quiet summary and leaves the optional sections out.

cli.logic-status-render.a-quiet-summary-.why: Without it, an empty section could start printing a stray line on every status call.

proves.claim: statusLines lists gone seats only when the all option is set.

cli.logic-status-render.all-shows-gone-s.why: Without it, status would list or hide gone seats against the --all flag.
